item.title: Danette Mitchell: Happy 100th birthday to Black History Month
item.description: Black History Month is as significant as the celebrations of other cultures in this country. We’re all strengthened as we commemorate a century of acknowledging and valuing each other’s stories and experiences with renewed interest and appreciation.

item.title: Vallejo volunteers tally unhoused for PIT count
item.description: Fifty volunteers scoured Vallejo Thursday morning, as part of a nationwide initiative to tally those experiencing homelessness. The city-led census, known as the Point In Time (PIT) count, led locals on a search for community connections with one of the city’s more vulnerable populations — the unhoused.
